title: wqformat
text: default, wqformat accepts eight different formats, listed . Converting data accepted formats simple process: use format_results() format water quality results format_sites() format site metadata. functions update column names, update variable names, standardize units. Accepted formats. Water quality result data supported formats, however site data supported Maine DEP Rhode Island DEM. format result data MassWateR WQdashboard, may use format_mwr_results() format_wqd_results() respectively.
